newsitem.title: USA: Unicom Corp Q3 net off.
newsitem.headline: Unicom Corp Q3 net off.

text.p: (All Data Above 000s Except Per Share Numbers)
(All Data Above 000s Except Per Share Numbers)
NOTE: 1996 Q3 net was reduced by $15 million, or $0.07/shr, because of increased depreciation. Effects of an income tax refund related to prior years increased net income by $26 million or $0.12/shr.
Offsetting the lower Q3 earnings were decreased interest expense and dividend requirements on preferred and preference stocks, which decreased by eight percent compared with the same 1995 quarter.

Contributing to 1996 nine-month results was a reduction in net income of $15 million, or $0.07/share, for increased depreciation charges. Partly offsetting lower earnings was a reduction in real estate taxes, which increased net by $23 million, or $0.11/share vs the same 1995 period. Effects of an income tax refund recorded in September 1996 increased net by $26 million, or $0.12/share.
